rules.sentence: Femoral hernias are less likely to occur than inguinal hernias; however, they are more likely to occur in elderly females.
They are protrusions of abdominal contents through a weakening in the femoral canal.
They create a bulge in the groin area and can lead to strangulation and necrosis of abdominal contents if not treated.
Any infection or hematoma can cause a mass effect injury near the psoas muscle or iliacus muscle.
Due to the relationship of these muscles to the femoral nerve, the growing abscess or hematoma can begin to compress the femoral nerve.
This can lead to nerve injury, potentially affecting motor or sensory innervation from the femoral nerve.
